text.p: Average yields at auctions of six-month, nine-month and 12-month Ukraine Treasury bills slipped and three-month yields were unchanged from the previous sales, a central bank statement said on Wednesday.

Three-month bills remained at 24.02 percent, six-month bills edged down to 29.99 percent from 31.27 percent, nine-month bills were down to 33.01 percent from 34.75 percent and 12-month bills slipped to 38.82 percent from 39.79 percent.
The results of Tuesday's three-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 3.00 million UAH 3.00 million UAH
Amount sold 0.84 million UAH 3.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 0.79 million UAH 2.83 million UAH
The central bank sold 8,413 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills is unfixed.
The results of the six-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated no limit stated
Amount sold 14.72 million UAH 10.75 million UAH
Actual amount raised 12.80 million UAH 9.31 million UAH
The central bank sold 147,198 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is unfixed.
The results of the nine-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated no limit stated
Amount sold 45.49 million UAH 13.29 million UAH
Actual amount raised 36.48 million UAH 10.55 million UAH
The central bank sold 454,900 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is unfixed.
The results of the 12-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated no limit stated
Amount sold 104.34 million UAH 19.94 million UAH
Actual amount raised 75.22 million UAH 14.27 million UAH
The central bank sold 1,043,424 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is unfixed.
